title: The reminders toggle snaps back while opt-in runs and can be tapped again; an unreadable record turns it off silently
evidence: Done by PR 1594 (937bb0608) and PR 1597 (76aa0d9f6): the switch reads one ReminderMode (Reminders/ReminderMode.swift; ReminderScheduler.swift:32-35), a tap while an ask is out asks nothing more, and a failed read (nil) is not an erase (ReminderMode.swift:35); pinned by ReminderModeTests.testEveryModeAndEvent_US25_AC12b. Was: ios/HealthRoadmap/Reminders/RemindersSection.swift:13-21; ReminderScheduler.swift:23-28,47,86 (reminders == nil means both not loaded and unreadable).
